Hymn 292: O My Father
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: A-flat Major
Composer: James McGranahan
Lyricist/Text Author: Eliza R. Snow
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 292 titled "O My Father" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in A-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by James McGranahan and the lyrics were written by Eliza R. Snow.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
